title: Reserve stock
trap: Check-then-act across awaits: many concurrent reserve calls all read the same stock and oversell unless the read-modify-write is serialized.
prompt: Add reserve(store, sku, qty) to src/stock.js. It takes qty units out of the stock the store holds for sku and resolves to the quantity left. If fewer than qty units are available it rejects with an Error and leaves the stock unchanged. The store (src/store.js) only offers async get(sku) and set(sku, qty). Add tests in test/stock.test.js.
